text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One of its main goals is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP is also used in translation, so tools like Google Translate can change text from one language to another quickly. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, which helps companies find out if customers feel positive or negative about a product. Finally, chatbots use NLP to communicate with people in a natural way, answering questions and solving problems. Thanks to NLP, our daily life with technology is becoming easier and more comfortable.
